entries.title: Acts 10:1
segments: There was then in Caesarea a man named Cornelius, a Captain in the regiment known as the 'Italian Regiment,'

entries.title: Acts 10:2
segments: A religious man and one who reverenced God, with all his household. He was liberal in his charities to the people, and prayed to God constantly.

entries.title: Acts 10:3
segments: One afternoon, about three o'clock, he distinctly saw in a vision an angel from God come to him, and call him by name.

entries.title: Acts 10:4
segments: Cornelius fixed his eyes on him and, in great alarm, said: "What is it, Lord?" "Your prayers and your charities," the angel answered, "have been an acceptable offering to God.

entries.title: Acts 10:5
segments: And now, send messengers to Jaffa and fetch a man called Simon, who is also known as Peter.

entries.title: Acts 10:6
segments: He is lodging with a tanner named Simon, who has a house near the sea."

entries.title: Acts 10:7
segments: When the angel, who had spoken to him, had gone, Cornelius called two menservants and a religious soldier, who was one of his constant attendants,

entries.title: Acts 10:8
segments: And, after telling them the whole story, sent them to Jaffa.

entries.title: Acts 10:9
segments: On the next day, while these men were on their way, just as they were nearing the town, Peter went up on the housetop about mid-day to pray.

entries.title: Acts 10:10
segments: He became hungry and wanted something to eat; but while it was being prepared, he fell into a trance,

entries.title: Acts 10:11
segments: And saw that the heavens were open, and that something like a great sail was descending, let down by its four corners towards the earth.

entries.title: Acts 10:12
segments: In it were all kinds of quadrupeds, reptiles, and birds.

entries.title: Acts 10:13
segments: Then he was aware of a voice which said--"Stand up, Peter, kill something, and eat."

entries.title: Acts 10:14
segments: "No, Lord, I cannot," answered Peter, "for I have never eaten anything 'defiled' and 'unclean'."

entries.title: Acts 10:15
segments: Again he was aware of a voice which said--"What God has pronounced 'clean', do not regard as 'defiled'."

entries.title: Acts 10:16
segments: This happened three times, and then suddenly it was all taken up into the heavens.

entries.title: Acts 10:17
segments: While Peter was still perplexed as to the meaning of the vision that he had seen, the men sent by Cornelius, having enquired the way to Simon's house, came up to the gate,

entries.title: Acts 10:18
segments: And called out and asked if the Simon, who was also known as Peter, was lodging there.

entries.title: Acts 10:19
segments: Peter was still pondering over the vision, when the Spirit said to him: "There are two men looking for you at this moment.

entries.title: Acts 10:20
segments: Go down at once and do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them."

entries.title: Acts 10:21
segments: Peter went down to the men and said: "I am the man for whom you are looking. What is your reason for coming?"

entries.title: Acts 10:22
segments: The men replied: "Our captain, Cornelius, a pious man who reverences God and is well spoken of by the whole Jewish nation, has been instructed by a holy angel to send for you to his house, and to listen to what you have to say."

entries.title: Acts 10:23
segments: Upon this Peter invited them in and entertained them. The next day he lost no time in setting out with them, accompanied by some of the Brethren from Jaffa;

entries.title: Acts 10:24
segments: And the day following he entered Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them, and had invited his relations and intimate friends to meet them.

entries.title: Acts 10:25
segments: So, when Peter entered the city, Cornelius met him, and, throwing himself at Peter's feet, bowed to the ground.

entries.title: Acts 10:26
segments: Peter, however, lifted him up, saying as he did so: "Stand up, I am only a man like yourself."

entries.title: Acts 10:27
segments: Talking with him as he went, Peter entered the house, where he found a large gathering of people, to whom he said:

entries.title: Acts 10:28
segments: "You are doubtless aware that it is forbidden for a Jew to be intimate with a foreigner, or even to enter his house; and yet God has shown me that I ought not to call any man 'defiled' or 'unclean.'

entries.title: Acts 10:29
segments: That was why I came, when I was sent for, without raising any objection. And now I ask your reason for sending for me."

entries.title: Acts 10:30
segments: "Just three days ago this very hour," Cornelius said, "I was in my house, saying the Afternoon Prayers, when a man in dazzling clothing suddenly stood before me.

entries.title: Acts 10:31
segments: 'Cornelius,' he said, 'your prayer has been heard, and your charities have been accepted, by God.

entries.title: Acts 10:32
segments: Therefore send to Jaffa, and invite the Simon, who is also known as Peter, to come here. He is lodging in the house of Simon the tanner, near the sea.'

entries.title: Acts 10:33
segments: Accordingly I sent to you at once, and you have been so good as to come. And now we are all here in the presence of God, to listen to all that you have been instructed by the Lord to say."

entries.title: Acts 10:34
segments: Then Peter began. "I see, beyond all doubt," he said, "that 'God does not show partiality,'

entries.title: Acts 10:35
segments: But that in every nation he who reverences him and does what is right is acceptable to him.

entries.title: Acts 10:36
segments: God has sent his Message to the Israelites and told them, through Jesus Christ, the Good News of peace--and Jesus is Lord of all!

entries.title: Acts 10:37
segments: You yourselves know the story which spread through all Judea, how, beginning form Galilee, after the baptism which John proclaimed--

entries.title: Acts 10:38
segments: The story, I mean, of Jesus of Nazareth, and how God consecrated him his Christ by enduing him with the Holy Spirit and with power; and how he went about doing good and curing all who were under the power of the Devil, because God was with him.

entries.title: Acts 10:39
segments: We are ourselves, too, witnesses to all that he did in Judea and in Jerusalem; yet they put him to death by hanging him on a cross!

entries.title: Acts 10:40
segments: This Jesus God raised on the third day, and enabled him to appear,

entries.title: Acts 10:41
segments: Not indeed to every one, but to witnesses chosen beforehand by God--to us, who ate and drank with him after his resurrection from the dead.

entries.title: Acts 10:42
segments: Further, God charged us to proclaim to the people, and solemnly affirm, that it is Jesus who has been appointed by God Judge of the living and the dead.

entries.title: Acts 10:43
segments: To him it is that all the Prophets bear witness, when they say that every one who believes in him receives through his Name forgiveness of sins."

entries.title: Acts 10:44
segments: Before Peter had finished saying these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all who were listening to the Message.

entries.title: Acts 10:45
segments: Those converts from Judaism, who had come with Peter, were amazed that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been bestowed even upon the Gentiles;

entries.title: Acts 10:46
segments: For they heard them speaking with 'tongues' and extolling God. At this Peter asked:

entries.title: Acts 10:47
segments: "Can any one refuse the water for the baptism of these people, now that they have received the Holy Spirit as we did ourselves?"

entries.title: Acts 10:48
segments: And he directed that they should be baptized in the Faith of Jesus Christ; after which they asked him to stay there a few days longer.
